INDUS-AD Monocam: Decoded Single-Camera Driving Dataset
	



AI-generated illustrative artwork; the road scene is not a dataset sample.

	
		
	
	
		Overview
	

INDUS-AD Monocam contains 96 single-camera driving recordings, published as 96 face/plate-blurred MP4s with 105,692 decoded frames, normalized sensor tables, and derived semantic and depth layers. The current decoded release occupies approximately 36.02 GB, including 22.85 GB of camera video.
Part of INDUS-AD—Indian Dataset… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/gagandeepreehal/indus-ad-monocam.
